description.en:
Mod for Farming Simulator.
Streams your own farm's state (vehicles, fleet, fields, animals, production, contracts, weather and prices) out of the game so a program on your PC can show it, and runs ordinary in-game actions when that program asks. Nothing leaves your machine: it talks over a local pipe and never uses the network.
This mod is free and open source under the MIT license. Anyone can use it, change it, and build their own tools on it. Source, protocol, and download: https://github.com/getflowkits/fs25-farmhand-mod
I use it as the data source for FS25 Farmhand, my Stream Deck plugin. That plugin is separate software and can install this mod for you, but the mod does not need it and costs nothing either way.
Enable it for your savegame in this list.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by GIANTS Software.
